title: How I AI: How Meta designed Muse with Alex Cornell
author: Lenny Rachitsky
description: Your weekly listens from How I AI, part of the Lenny's Podcast Network
summary: How Meta designed Muse: an AI agent people actually want to talk to | Alex Cornell (Design Director) Listen now on YouTube • Spotify • Apple Podcasts Brought to you by: WorkOS —Make your app enterprise-ready, with SSO, SCIM, RBAC, and more Alex Cornell is a design director at Meta, where he leads design for Muse. In this episode, he explains how progressive disclosure makes Muse approachable for casual users without
takeaways: Many AI products display reasoning steps to reassure users while a slow model works.
Muse is fast enough to operate quietly, showing that agents do not need to perform their thinking when they can simply deliver the result.
Learning to judge the results by usefulness rather than visual precision has been one of the most liberating shifts in his career.
